items.text: Water fountains on the fourth floor of Keating Hall will be closed for repairs from Monday, April 7, through Wednesday, April 9. Bottled water is available at the Facilities Office, Room 112, between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM. We apologize for any inconvenience.

questions.stem: According to the notice, when will the fountains be closed?
questions.explanation: The notice states the fountains will be closed for repairs from Monday, April 7, through Wednesday, April 9.

questions.stem: What can be inferred about getting drinking water during the closure period?

options.A: Students on other floors also lack water.
options.B: The building's water supply is cut off.
options.C: Repairs will end earlier than planned.
options.D: Students must go elsewhere for water.

questions.explanation: Since the fourth-floor fountains are unavailable, the notice directs people to Room 112 of the Facilities Office for bottled water, implying they must travel to another spot.
